metadata.title: CLS — WASM-first programming language
metadata.description: A modular, secure and cross-platform programming language that compiles to WebAssembly. Built for scripting, plugins and general-purpose applications.

hero.subtitle: CLS is a modular, secure and cross-platform programming language. Scripting, plugins and general-purpose applications with a minimal core and host nodes that extend it.

features.title: Built for the future
features.subtitle: A language with a clear philosophy: everything is WASM, the core is minimal and nodes extend the functionality.

wasm.title: WASM-first
wasm.description: Compiler, runtime and apps compile to WebAssembly. Runs in any WASM-capable environment.

jit.title: JIT with Cranelift
jit.description: Just-in-time execution from CLS to WASM with wasmtime. Up to ~8000x faster than the tree-walker.

ffi.title: Native FFI
ffi.description: Direct interop with C libraries via the `extension` directive, with dedicated ABI types.

oop.title: OOP with magic methods
oop.description: Classes, inheritance, generics and magic methods: `__toString`, `__iter`, `__get` and more.

modules.title: Module system
modules.description: Two orthogonal systems: source imports and compiled `.clslib` libraries.

cmx.title: Native CMX
cmx.description: JSX-like markup directly in the language to build interfaces with `CmxValue`.

pipeline.title: How it works
pipeline.subtitle: From source code to WebAssembly bytecode through a clear, testable pipeline.

step1.title: Lexer + Parser
step1.description: Your `.clsx` code is tokenized and parsed into a serializable AST.

step2.title: Type checker
step2.description: TypeScript-style type checking with unions, generics and literals.

step4.title: WASM backend
step4.description: WASM emission: JIT with wasmtime or `.clbin` binaries in the future.

stdlib.title: Standard library
stdlib.subtitle: Compact, focused modules that cover day-to-day needs.

cta.title: Ready to write CLS?
cta.subtitle: Install the CLI, create your first project and compile to WebAssembly.

about.title: About CLS
about.subtitle: A modular, secure and cross-platform programming language.
about.philosophy1: Everything is WASM: compiler, runtime and apps compile to WebAssembly.
about.philosophy2: The core is minimal; nodes (host executables) extend the functionality.
about.philosophy3: Host-agnostic: runs in any WASM-capable environment.
about.philosophy4: Embeddable from Rust, Python, JS, Go, C# and more.
about.layersSubtitle: A clean separation between the language, the runtime and the host.

layer1.title: cls-core
layer1.description: The language: lexer, parser, type checker, optimizer and backends. Environment-agnostic.

layer2.title: cls-runtime
layer2.description: The runtime: tree-walker interpreter, values, stdlib, GC and sandboxed VFS.

layer3.title: nodes
layer3.description: The hosts: clx (dev CLI) and clxr (lightweight runtime). They provide FS, network, CLI and config.

about.roadmapSubtitle: From the tree-walker interpreter to native compilation.
about.f4: Stdlib: math, json, fs, http, intrinsics
about.extra: LSP + VS Code extension + type maps + async/await + CMX + errors with traces
about.repoDescription: Explore the repository, contribute or open an issue.
